llm_response.reason: The website mimics the design and branding of Lazada, a well-known legitimate e-commerce platform, but is hosted on an unrelated domain with no real company information. It features unusually low prices (up to -95%), excessive bonuses, urgency/psychological triggers for fast deposits, and directs login and account actions to suspicious external links (ogetherde.org, t.ly). The domain is newly registered (July 2025), and company/contact information and privacy policies are ambiguous or missing, all aligning precisely with typical scam characteristics for Fake Online Shopping.
